finding: Watering logs and sensor events are unrelated
detected_by: 31 of 34 watering logs have no moisture rise within 6h -- and 3 hits is below the ~3.5 expected by chance, so the matches carry no information. All four log types were tested against the channel their own event should move, and none lines up. LIGHT CONTRADICTS: 'Moved closer to window' moves the daily light peak DOWN by 4.4 on average, the opposite of what it claims (n=3, within the daily sd of 5.3 -- suggestive, not proof). The sensor's own rises land exactly on the hour -- 35 of 37 excluding SENS-08 -- while the logs are all at human times, so the two look independently generated
next: do not use logs as event ground truth; ask firmware whether the device does anything at 00:00
